newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-REDONDO SAYS 'NO' TO ARGENTINA RECALL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REDONDO SAYS 'NO' TO ARGENTINA RECALL.

text.p: Real Madrid midfielder Fernando Redondo said on Wednesday he would not accept Daniel Passarella's invitation to return to the Argentine national side after an absence of more than two years.
"It's a question of honour...The relations with the coaching team aren't right for me to join the team," he said.
Redondo was a key player in the Argentine team at the 1994 World Cup but has not played under Passarella, who banned long hair and ear-rings when he took over from Alfio Basile.
More recently, Passarella claimed Redondo had been excluded because the two could not agree on his role in the team.
But Argentina's problems in qualifying for next year's World Cup have prompted a change of heart by Passarella.
